# BizAnalyzer.nl — AI Business Analyzer for the Netherlands

BizAnalyzer.nl is a free multilingual platform (Arabic, Dutch, English) that helps migrants and entrepreneurs analyze business ideas for the Dutch market.

## About

BizAnalyzer.nl provides AI-powered business analysis for the Dutch market. The platform is built for migrants, status holders, expats, and entrepreneurs in the Netherlands.
